record.title: CELL4 ForcedTop25 realization and qualification MID
record.body: CELL4 consumed exact CELL3 allocation commit 1077b0dcb1f947d7dc05a1af56dda2cc15fa6671 without restarting SELECT. CELL3 selected_workstreams=[] and ready_set=[], so no downstream repository mutation was lawful this wave. Exact requalification of autofde-lab#88@d1a27aec3cf7c86d56e7e67e2fa781a7e94d6d5a, autofde#33@bf753d1dfdc137a6fce04008a2841752216654bb, and xaas#32@35b6b49f8d63580d4d94d5fd938753d32509cc86 proved one shared producer defect: ggen@ddfa602bfbab57b7ed5150f61b0acac7a41e3020 refuses forced-top25-admissibility-factory-pack/pack.toml because top-level [qualification] is outside the admitted schema (expected only pack). CELL4 returned that defect upstream once on ggen-marketplace PR #321, exact base 9bba137bf2ceb43c4694ac8c580c459782e09643, head 2b3d6a9cc86ee6fe7b4ce267fb01433ce9201253, with two unique upstream commits: remove the unsupported namespace and add a permanent minimal-manifest schema court. Consumers remain non-ready until the repaired producer is admitted and regeneration/re-execution occurs. XaaS also has an independent target-local native-CI Andon: compile succeeds, then ExUnit 1.18.4 rejects setup return {:skip, ...} in AutofdePlannerCrossProductTest when cnv-deploy is absent. Consequential DO=false; no merge/release/deploy/external actuation.
